rootHelp:
Usage: change-firewall [options] [command]

The deterministic trust layer & referee for autonomous AI coding agents.
Verifies agent actions, blast radius, invariant memory, and crash proofs.

Options:
  -V, --version                  output the version number
  -h, --help                     display help for command

Commands:
  analyze [options]              Deterministic verification of code changes,
                                 downstream blast radius, and contract
                                 invariants
  interactive|inspect [options]  Launch keyboard-driven interactive terminal
                                 inspector (Tab: call stacks, p: crash proof, f:
                                 fingerprint, a: auto-fix)
  preflight|gate [options]       Determine whether the current changes are safe
                                 to merge (exit 0 for safe, exit 1 for blocked)
  open [options]                 Start and open the local dashboard with current
                                 working tree analysis
  impact <file>                  Inspect the blast radius and downstream
                                 dependents of a specific file
  watch [options]                Live watch mode: automatically re-analyzes on
                                 AI changes and updates local dashboard via SSE
  why <file>                     Explain why a file matters to the architecture,
                                 its role, history, and dependents
  demo [options]                 Run an interactive simulated AI change scenario
                                 (Section 7 Golden Moment) with live dashboard
  mcp                            Start Model Context Protocol (MCP) server over
                                 stdio for Claude Desktop, Antigravity, and
                                 Cursor
  graph <file>                   Display the architectural Behavior Graph and
                                 critical paths for a specific file/symbol
  memory [action]                Manage persistent contract memory (status,
                                 record, reset)
  audit-agent [options]          Audit stated AI agent intent (commit message or
                                 prompt) against actual uncommitted diffs
  help [command]                 display help for command

commands.name: analyze
commands.help:
Usage: change-firewall analyze [options]

Deterministic verification of code changes, downstream blast radius, and
contract invariants

Options:
  --json               Output results in JSON format for CI and AI agents
  --interactive        Launch keyboard-driven interactive terminal inspector
                       (Tab: call stacks, p: crash proof, f: fingerprint, a:
                       auto-fix)
  --inspect            Alias for --interactive
  --open               Start and open local web dashboard at localhost:4783
  -p, --port <number>  Port for the local dashboard (default: "4783")
  -b, --base <ref>     Base git commit or branch to compare against (default:
                       HEAD)
  -s, --staged         Only analyze staged changes
  -i, --intent <text>  Audit AI agent stated intent vs actual code mutations
  --record-memory      Record verified baseline snapshot into persistent memory
                       (.firewall/memory)
  -h, --help           display help for command

  -s, --staged      Only inspect staged changes
  -h, --help        display help for command

commands.name: preflight
commands.help:
Usage: change-firewall preflight|gate [options]

Determine whether the current changes are safe to merge (exit 0 for safe, exit 1
for blocked)

Options:
  -m, --max-risk <number>   Maximum acceptable risk score before blocking merge
                            (default: "60")
  -t, --threshold <number>  Alias for --max-risk (threshold score)
  --no-fail-on-high         Do not automatically fail on high severity
                            behavioral findings
  --json                    Output preflight evaluation result as JSON
  -b, --base <ref>          Base git commit or branch to compare against
                            (default: HEAD)
  -s, --staged              Only evaluate staged changes
  -h, --help                display help for command
